release_sha_format_note: FULL 40-char sha ON PURPOSE. ap14.AC2.sh compares EC2_MANIFEST's deployed_commit to this field as strings ([ "$dep" = "$rel" ]); the manifest stores the full sha, so a short release_sha could never match and a CORRECT deploy would have graded FAIL.
